# Thermal Supply Inc.

> > Industrial supply distributor specializing in HVAC, refrigeration, and plumbing equipment, parts, and tools for commercial and residential applications.

Thermal Supply Inc. operates multiple branch locations including Seattle and Billings, MT, offering a comprehensive catalog of HVAC equipment, refrigeration components, diagnostic tools, and industrial supplies. The company carries major brands like Daikin, DIVERSITECH, and Ecco-Flex, serving contractors and technicians across the Pacific Northwest and Mountain regions.

## Key Topics

- HVAC equipment and systems
- Refrigeration parts and components
- Temperature monitoring and data logging
- Diagnostic tools and instruments
- Plumbing supplies
- Industrial adhesives and chemicals
- Ductwork and ventilation products
- Daikin products and DR Series
- DIVERSITECH CORPORATION brands
- M2 Revolver manifolds
- LOGiT temperature recorders
- AFUE ratings and energy efficiency
- Carbon monoxide detection
- Filter cores and driers
- Ignition controls and burner components

## HVAC Equipment & Systems

- [Equipment](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/413/equipment): HVAC equipment catalog with AFUE ratings and capacity filter options
- [Humidifiers](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/366/humidifiers): HVAC humidifiers with capacity ratings and filterable search options
- [Ignition](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/475/ignition): HVAC ignition components and burner ignition controls for heating systems

## Refrigeration & Diagnostic Tools

- [Manifolds](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/146/manifolds): Refrigeration manifolds including M2 Revolver series & gauge accessories
- [Recorders and Loggers](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/350/recorders-and-loggers): Temperature recorders & data loggers including Daikin DR Series & LOGiT
- [Filter Cores](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/448/filter-cores): Refrigerant filter cores & drier cartridges including BTAS series
- [Carbon Monoxide Detectors](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/347/carbon-monoxide-detectors): Carbon monoxide detectors including CO1000 test instruments for HVAC

## Ductwork & Ventilation Products

- [Aluminum Products](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/570/aluminum-products): Aluminum ducting, chimney liners, dryer vents including Ecco-Flex
- [Ductboard Spin-Ins](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/601/ductboard-spin-ins): Ductboard spin-ins from ECCO and Southwark for HVAC ventilation

## Tools & Hardware

- [Hand Tools](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/236/hand-tools): HVAC & plumbing hand tools for tube fitting and duct work

- [Threaded Rod](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/234/threaded-rod): Threaded rod pipe hangers & supports from ZSI-Foster and Wesanco

## Adhesives, Chemicals & Maintenance

- [Adhesives](https://shop.thermalsupplyinc.com/catsearch/121/adhesives): Industrial adhesives including Armaflex, Boss, J-B Weld, and LA-CO
